notes.title: A Tapestry of Old and New Titles! RPG Maker Festival 2025 Begins! Celebrate Over
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9372513/b4645591bfd53a650090cbdd251797c26a158406.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]About RPG Maker Festival 2025[/b][/h1]
Maker Day (Tsukuru no Hi, February 15th) is the day for recognizing and spreading the joy of making games! 
To celebrate this day, we are holding the online event 'RPG Maker Festival' again this year!

The "RPG Maker Festival" is a grand event with the theme of "Creators and players, everyone is the star!"
There'll be new releases and lots of discounts for RPG Maker products, DLCs, and a large number of games created with RPG Maker.
This year, the number of participating titles is [b]1074 games[/b] - a record for the event! Don't miss your chance to discover new masterpieces and make some great purchases.

Additionally 2025 represents the 5th anniversary for RPG Maker MZ, the 10th anniversary for RPG Maker MV, and the 25th anniversary for RPG Maker 2000! To celebrate these anniversaries, RPG Maker Festival 2025  is spread out over 2 weeks due to all we have planned! We hope you will be with us for the whole journey!


■RPG Maker Festival 2025 Dates
Phase 1: February 4th, 2025  until February 11th 2025. 
Phase 2: February 11th 2025 until February 18th 2025

■Phase 1 Event URL
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/RPGMakerFestival2025]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/RPGMakerFestival2025[/url]


[h1][b]Part One Events
RPG Maker VX Ace Available For Free[/b][/h1]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9372513/56da34f7c8f2288ed6423a5c4b7436d17d44d9e2.png[/img]
It’s our pleasure to announce that for a limited time, RPG MakerVX Ace, with global sales exceeding 500,000 copies,  will be available for free download!
It set the roadmap for the actors, items, database and other functions that carry through to RPG Maker MZ today! Even today many fans love the feel provided by RPG Maker VX Ace! We hope many people will give it a try during this limited opportunity!

■ Free Download Period
February 4th until February 11th, 2025
･URL： [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/RPGMakerFestival2025]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/RPGMakerFestival2025[/url]


[h1][b]Big Sales! RPG Maker MZ 55％ Off, RPG Maker MV 93％ Off
[/b][/h1] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9372513/ef51407d44f485052ef03984944cffa1a4a224d8.png[/img]
RPG Maker MZ is discounted 55％ on Steam to celebrate it’s 5th anniversary! RPG Maker MV, celebrating it’s 10th anniversary,  will be available at the amazing value of 93％ off on Steam!
Additionally, a major update is coming very soon for RPG Maker MZ, making it even easier to use!
And for those who are already owners of some RPG Maker titles, there’s special celebration available with even more discounts!

[h2][b]RPG Maker Game Celebrations
[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9372513/0b30ddf0f8f8a93e0f89bd6bded9a8b443df3193.png[/img]
RPG Maker is more than just the engine; it’s also all the games that the community has made over the many years! To celebrate these creations, event pages have been created on both Steam and DLsite!

[/h2][/b] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9372513/863f164cbc880c65b9e2e3a2c40ee218a83c396f.png[/img]
The latest entry in the Maker franchise, ACTION GAME MAKER will announce it’s release date on February 17th, 2025!　And that’s not all: a brand new trailer will be released showing never before seen footage!
・ACTION GAME MAKER URL：[url=https://youtu.be/JSjN67Bc_jo]https://youtu.be/JSjN67Bc_jo[/url]

Designed to allow anyone to make 2D action games without programming and built on top of Godot Engine, ACTION GAME MAKER represents a new step forward for the Maker franchise.
And with plenty of included assets, you’ll be able to get started on your game making journey!
Please visit the Steam page and wishlist it now!

・ACTION GAME MAKER Steam page：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2987180/ACTION_GAME_MAKER/?utm_source=PR&utm_campaign=referral&utm_medium=RPGMakerFestival2025_SteamNews_EN]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2987180/ACTION_GAME_MAKER/?utm_source=PR&utm_campaign=referral&utm_medium=RPGMakerFestival2025_SteamNews_EN[/url]


[b][h2]RPG Maker 2000 DLC Reborn
[/h2][/b] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9372513/4833f34677f6988078129e17a786e29b381ea8b3.png[/img]
It’s been an amazing 25 years since RPG Maker 2000 first released! To celebrate, we’re bringing back some content that was released with the RPG Maker 2000 Handbook specifically for RPG Maker MZ!
Tile sets and characters, animations, sound effects and voice lines and so much more are included! And all remastered for use with RPG Maker MZ! In addition, the original assets in their RPG Maker 2000/2003 compatible format are included as well!
Whether you’re a collector who never had the opportunity to get the Handbook or you just like the look of these assets, this is an amazing opportunity!

・RPG Maker 2000 Handbook Assets Steam Page：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3478100/RPG_Maker_MZ__RPG_Maker_2000_Handbook_Assets/?utm_source=PR&utm_campaign=referral&utm_medium=RPGMakerFestival2025_SteamNews_EN]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3478100/RPG_Maker_MZ__RPG_Maker_2000_Handbook_Assets/?utm_source=PR&utm_campaign=referral&utm_medium=RPGMakerFestival2025_SteamNews_EN[/url]


[h1][b]Phase Two Events[/b][/h1]
During phase two of RPG Maker Festival 2025, the discounts and content sharing will continue! We’re not prepared to release that information, so we hope you will remain excited until it is unveiled at the start of phase two!

notes.title: 1.0.6.13 Beta Release!
notes.content:
Dear PGMMV Users,

Thank you for your continued support of PGMMV!
Version 1.0.6.13 is now available for download via the Beta channel!
In addition to a few fixes, there are 2 functions being added with 1.0.6.13. 
The first is the addition of Invincibility duration to the Received Damage settings. This will allow configuration of different invincibility times based on which type of element hits the Object, making invincibility a much more flexible feature to use.
The second new feature affects Fields of Vision. Previously, they had a fixed direction and would not change based on Object orientation. With 1.0.6.13, Fields of Vision will now update according to an Objects orientation. This should make all kinds of functionality much easier to implement, for top or side view games!

[h2]Ver. 1.0.6.13 (Beta) Release Notes[/h2]
[h3]Editor[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added Invincibility configuration settings to the Received Damage settings.
[/list]
[h3]Player[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fields of Vision now rotate to follow Object orientation.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause child Objects to lose track of the parent’s instance ID after a portal is used when the parent is the Player.
[*]Fixed a bug that could prevent bullet Objects from functioning correctly when set to use the “Shoot at the Selected On-Screen Object Group(s)” setting in some situations.
[/list]
To apply this Beta version please change the branch to 1.0.6-beta via the Steam library.
Also, we remind users participating in the Nintendo Switch publishing program to continue using the 1.0.6-switch-beta branch when working on Switch builds.
[How to Change Branch]
[h3]Caution: We strongly recommend backing up your project before attempting the following. [/h3]
1.Go to Steam Library, right click "Pixel Game Maker MV" and select "Properties".
2.Click on the "Beta" tab, select the target version from the Beta Participation menu and close "Properties".

[Reverting Back to Default]
Follow the instructions below to switch from the Beta version back to the previous version.
1.Go to Steam Library, right click "Pixel Game Maker MV" and select "Properties".
2.Select "None" for Beta Participation and close "Properties".
Please continue enjoying your game dev life with PGMMV!

notes.title: Releasing Stable Version 1.0.6.12!
notes.content:
Hello dear PGM users!
Thank you for your continued support of Pixel Game Maker MV!
We have now formally released the default stable branch version 1.0.6.12.
Stable version updates are distributed automatically to all users. For users who wish to stay in the previous Ver1.0.6.3, please follow the instruction [How to Change Branch] at the bottom and change to version 1.0.6 – legacy.

With the release of 1.0.6.12, as with the current main branch, it will not be possible to access the Nintendo Switch functions properly. To address this, users who need access to Nintendo Switch functionality will be asked to try the 1.0.6-switch beta branch.

[h2]stable version 1.0.6.12 release note[/h2]
[h3]Editor[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added new Option: enables selection for specific versions to use for the Player, Runtime, and Debugging Runtime components.
[*]Fixed issue that could cause a crash when trying to do an encrypted build of a project with a large file size.
[*]Fixed issue when displaying particles on the menu layer which could prevent the connection point from being acquired.
[/list]

[h3]Player[/h3]
[list]
[*]Improved display options for the F1 debug menu.
[*]Fixed a texture display issue caused by using the F1 debug menu to forcibly change languages.
[*]Fixed issue that could cause saved data to be generated in an unintended location.
[*]Fixed issue that caused the “Apply Damage Rate to Parent” option for Child Objects to not work properly.
[*]Fixed issue where GIF animations do not display properly after scaling is changed.
[*]Fixed issue preventing WebM format videos from playing properly.
[*]Added the "Controller Settings" F1 menu item. It allows changing of the active controller.
[*]The amount of memory that can be handled by the player component has been increased from 2GB to 4 GB.
[/list]

[How to Change Branch] 
[h3] Caution: We strongly recommend backing up your project before attempting the following. [/h3]
1. Go to Steam Library, right click "Pixel Game Maker MV" and select "Properties".
2. Click on the "Beta" tab, select correct version and close "Properties".

[Reverting Back to Default]
Follow the instructions below to switch from the Beta version back to the previous version.
1. Go to Steam Library, right click "Pixel Game Maker MV" and select "Properties".
2. Select "None" and close "Properties".

Please continue enjoying game dev life with PGM MV!

notes.title: 1.0.6.12 Beta Release & Patch Notes!
notes.content:
Dear PGM Users,

Thank you for your continued support of PGMMV!
Version 1.0.6.12 is now available for download via the Beta channel!
Due to some performance issues within the editor, version 1.0.6.12 is reverting the version of Qt used with Pixel Game Maker MV to an earlier version while we work towards a long term solution.
Unfortunately, it was determined that when we updated Qt to address the issue preventing users from logging in to a Nintendo account, a number of unexpected side effects were also created.
With the release of 1.0.6.12, as with the current main branch, it will not be possible to access the Nintendo Switch functions properly. To address this, users who need access to Nintendo Switch functionality will be asked to try the new 1.0.6-switch branch.
This is intended solely as a provisional measure while a permanent fix is implemented. We apologize for the continued inconvenience while we work on further improvements.

[list]

notes.title: Release of the Player Component as Open Source
notes.content:
Everyone,
Thank you for your use of Pixel Game Maker MV over the last several years!

After much discussion, we have decided to release the Player component of Pixel Game Maker MV as open source software via a GitHub repository.

At this time, only the Player component, which is used to play games built with Pixel Game Maker MV, will be open sourced. The Editor component will remain closed source for the foreseeable future.

It is our hope to achieve the following 2 objectives with this decision:

[h2]1. Enable creators to use a customized version of the player that improves performance for their game.[/h2]
By writing game-specific code or removing unused functionality, the player component can be customized to be more efficient for a specific game.
Note that due to some security concerns, games built with encrypted data will not load correctly on a customized Player component. We apologize for this limitation, and ask for your understanding.

[h2]2. Improving Bug Fix Rate[/h2]
As the Player will now be open source, it will be possible for anyone in the Pixel Game Maker MV community to submit a pull request for any bugs they find & fix. Contributors will have their names added to the Pixel Game Maker MV developer credits

Please access the Pixel Game Maker MV GitHub repository for details.

We have started the next phase of this project, but we remain committed to Pixel Game Maker MV's continued development. We look forward to improving the experience with you, our community.

[h2]GitHub Repository[/h2]
https://github.com/GGGweb-adm/PGMMV

[h2]Using A Customized Player Component[/h2]
From November 21, 2023, it will be possible to use a customized Player component via the “1.0.6-Osplayer-beta” branch on Steam.
*This is otherwise identical to version 1.0.6.8.

After enabling this branch, you will have the option to specify versions to use for the Player, Runtine, and Debugging Runtime components.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32941247/f76468226a1b79f46093ae5e70ccd12436523805.png[/img]
Player: This is the version of the Player component used when performing a test play via the PGMMV editor.
The default version is the normal Player component installed with PGMMV’s editor at (install folder)/player-win/player.exe.

Runtime: This is the version of the Player component packaged with a game during the build process, and thus is the version people who play your game will use.
The default version is the one included with a PGMMV install: (install folder)/resource/runtime.zip

Debugging Runtime: A version of the Runtime used when a game is built with the debug flag enabled.
The default version is the one included with a PGMMV install: (install folder)/resource/debugMenuRuntime.zip

Currently no components are selected when this beta branch is enabled, so please be sure to select Player components when first using this new branch.

[How to Change Branches]
[h3]Caution: We strongly recommend backing up your project before attempting the following. [/h3]
1.Go to Steam Library, right click "Pixel Game Maker MV" and select "Properties".
2.Click on the "Beta" tab, select the correct version and close "Properties".

[Reverting Back to Default]
Follow the instructions below to switch from the Beta version back to the previous version.
1.Go to Steam Library, right click "Pixel Game Maker MV" and select "Properties".
2.Select "None" and close "Properties".
Please continue enjoying your game dev life with PGMMV!

notes.title: (Hot Fix) Update 1.05.13 Released
notes.content:
Dear PGM Users！
Thank you for you continued support of PGM.
We have now updated the default branch to 1.0.5.13.

This is a hot fix for 1.0.5.12 where we have received many reports of movement speed and gravity seems to be broken when changing FPS.
This seems to be caused by the fix "Jump speed now properly syncs with the current frame rate." that we attempted in 1.0.5.12. 
As a hot fix, we have reversed this change back to as it was in 1.0.5.11 We will investigate further to pinpoint the root cause for our next patch.
As a result of this, the old issue "Jump height may fluctuate as FPS drops" may occur again for the time being.

We are terribly sorry for this inconvenience. 
Please allow us some time to correct this. We really appreciate your patience!

notes.title: Database Beta Update and Free DLC
notes.content:
Hi all,
We announced it last week, and now the Database Beta Update is finally here!
We have released an update for the branch "1.0.5-database"

If you wish to use the latest Database Beta Version update, please select “1.0.5-database” from the Beta tab.
We strongly recommend you to back-up your projects before proceeding to the update.
The default branch remains branch 1.0.4.

But that is not all! 
As we understand that the Database Function can be a bit hard to use at first, our power-users [url=https://twitter.com/Joewithoutme]Joe[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/BazratCreates]Baz[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/JustusPan]Justus[/url] have prepared some help for you!
The update includes a new sample project featuring two mechanisms, one showing a puzzle mechanism and one showing a level-up system.

Baz and Justus have recorded videos to explain the Database, and you can find them here:
[url=https://youtu.be/Rx_Dfex-fyo ]Baz tutorial[/url] (English with Japanese subtitles)  
[url=https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1mv41147y8/]Justus tutorial [/url](Simplified Chinese) (The tutorial will be released in a few hours)

With the release of the Database, we have achieved a milestone that will allow you to make deeper, more complex games. It is very exciting to see how you will use it!
However, please keep it mind it is still in Beta at this time and we are working hard on the final version. 
In the final version of the database, we plan to facilitate the creation of plugins.
And as usual, if you have any questions, you can find us on the Steam Forums, the support mail address and Twitter!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32941247/673602e5e832d918129f38deae1c5721273b0e25.gif[/img]

Another announcement, we have a new free DLC: UNIVERS2020.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1504511/Pixel_Game_Maker_MV__UNIVERS2020/
[url=https://twitter.com/Dot_Zo_Games]DotZo[/url] has made this project on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/819303097]Twitch[/url] (Japanese only) during the Digital Game Expo 2020, as a collaboration with Sprite Studio.
The new design of the heroine of Universe is very cute! Please have fun checking the mechanisms behind the boss!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32941247/ff994d4da540102b88bedd2b6b4f913021613073.gif[/img]

Finally, as the year ends, we would like to wholeheartedly thank you for your support in 2020. 
Everywhere in the world, 2020 has been a tough year, but we are so proud of what the PGMMV community has achieved!
Some of you have released a game, signed with publishers, made tutorials, guides, videos, helped others, participated in Jams and Contests using the engine, given feedback and suggestions... it was a year full of learning and full of surprises!

Our Customer Support team will take a break from December 28th, 2020 to January 4th, 2021 and we will be back next year to assist you!
Sorry in advance for the inconvenience, but please be sure that we can't wait to hear your feedback about the Database Beta version!

Happy Holidays!

notes.title: DLC containing tons of assets is now available! Free music DLC also added!
notes.content:
Hi All,
Thanks for using Pixel Game Maker MV!

Today we are releasing a DLC pack for Pixel Game Maker MV: the ""Weapon Assets (100 varieties) and Dot Robot Set""!
These were previously only distributed together with the packaged version of Pixel Game Maker MV in Japan, but are now available as DLC!


The "Weapon Assets (100 varieties)" set is chock full of various weapon assets, such as swords, axes, and other melee weapons, as well as staves, bows, and more. The set even includes "Weapon movement: Basic data" so that it can be used right out of the box! Additionally, the "Dot Robot" project data is also included in the "SampleGames" folder together with the weapon assets. This pack contains the Dot Robot main character, robots, enemies, backgrounds, and more, which should prove quite handy in creating your own games. Don't miss this opportunity to grab all these assets in one reasonably-priced bundle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32941247/3eeba7a810749eb2d17b1b9f3ae545c98b1c0889.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/972400/

We have also released two free DLC Music Packs, featuring music created by "Don", head of Japanese label "16dimensional Records"! These will be downloaded inside local files, so please feel free to use them as you like.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1496911/Pixel_Game_Maker_MV__Lobit_Music_Pack/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1496910/Pixel_Game_Maker_MV__Go__Gone_Square/

We hope this DLC comes in useful when creating your very own games!

Additionally, we are currently hard at work adding the "Database Function". We should have some new info regarding the Database Function around New Year, so be sure to keep an eye out!
We hope you continue to enjoy game development!

notes.title: Pixel Game Maker MV - New Roadmap Announcement!
notes.content:
Hi all,

Thanks for supporting Pixel Game Maker MV.

We have listened closely to everyone's requests, and now we would like to share with you the newly-revamped roadmap for the future of Pixel Game Maker MV.
Put simply, we will develop and roll out the upcoming features and functions in the following order:
[olist]
[*]  Addition of Database functionality
[*]  Addition of settings for erasing Attack detection in motion settings when an object hits Collision detection while Attack detection is valid
[*]  Addition of ability to copy shortcut nodes and action boxes
[*]  Addition of slider to adjust Object RGB
[*]  Addition of ability to acquire analog stick angle and inclination
[*]  Addition of string variables and input runtime actions  [list]
[*] Action text display, scrolling text display also supported
[*] Tag embedding support
[*] Both keyboard and digital keyboard input supported[/list]
[*]  Addition of function for adding and deleting options to the game player pulldown menu
[*]  Roguelike features
[/olist]

The long-awaited database function will be finished up and rolled out first!

We will continue to put our all into development on our end, so in the meantime we hope you all continue to enjoy creating the games of your dreams using Pixel Game Maker MV!

notes.content:
"Hi All,

Thank you very much for using Pixel Game Maker MV.
Version 1.0.3.0 has just been released."
[h1]Additions[/h1][list]
[*]Added "Release Lock" to Runtime Action 
[*]Added function that when new text is added by "Show Scrolling Text" and "Show Text" is named after the first 10 characters entered when added to Text resources

[*]Added the possibility to change the background color of Menu Scene (*Not reflected in-game)
[*]Added Transparency to  "Apply Filter Effects On Object"
[*]Added the display of Variable and Switch's memo on-cursor 
[*]Adjusted the behavior of the Child Object "Keep track of the parent object at regular interval", added a "Tracking Accuracy" setting
[*]Added adjustment items related to Wall Detection in the Project Settings
[*]Added the option ”Disable Screen Shake” to the Game's menu
[list][*]The Runtime action "Shake Scene" is disabled[/list]
[*]Added a plug-in to get the Language selected during the game
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes (Player)[/h1][list]
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause the variable " Display Direction" to not be updated
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a difference in the display of Physics Objects between the Editor and the Player
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a crash when an object is created without motion settings
[*]Fixed a bug that caused objects with the setting "Not Pushed Back by Other Objects" to have unexpected behavior when on a slope
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a crash when the loop set on a music is too short
[*]Fixed the behavior of "Set Duration Until Target Position (Seconds)" if using "Use Basic Move Parameter of Target Object" in "Move Object"
[list][*]Even when "Set Duration Until Target Position (Seconds)" is set, the movement can be changed by a jump or a directional move[/list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused deleted text to be late by 1F
[*]Fixed a bug that caused actions like "Fire Bullet" and "Generate Object" to function, even when the action is switched, if the animation is the same before the transfer
[*]Fixed a bug that caused bitmap to be used when setting a specific size of TTF
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the display direction to reset by the Runtime Action "Move Towards Display Direction"
[*]Fixed a bug that caused gauges to not be displayed as intended
[*]Fixed a bug that caused controller ID to be reset even when changed to "-1"
[*]Fixed a bug in the behavior of manipulated objects when they push each other 
[*]Changed the condition "Change Switch, Variable" to "When a player who has not touched the portal touches" in the Portal Condition Settings "Setting When Touched by Player" 
[*]Fixed a bug that caused characters controlled by keyboard to be controlled by both keyboard and controllers
[*]Fixed a bug in the Invincibility Related Settings
[list][*]If Invincibility Switch was not set, the object was constantly invincible
[*]The Invincibility Related Settings will be enabled when the Object's Invincibility Switch is ON or when the Object touches an Attack Detection box[/list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused an increased processing load then "Shake Scene" is executed while displaying a lot of text in the scene
[list][*]Adjusted in addition to the previous version update[/list]
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a crash when a "Move Object" Runtime action is executed for an Object in a Menu Scene
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the Wall Detection of Objects in Menu Scene to not be displayed in debug mode  
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the tracking by Child object to not work as expected when the Parent Object changes by "Change Object"  
[*]Fixed a bug that caused some webm files to not be read correctly
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Bullets which are set on tracking to move to the target coordinates at the time of firing
[*]Fixed a bug that caused child objects to be deleted when moving through a portal after loading the file
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the jump to continue to rise after restarting the game, when stopped and displaying text
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the movement of an Object set with the Runtime Action "Move Object" to continue even if the game speed is set to 0%
[/list]
[h1]Adjustment (Player)[/h1][list]
[*]Adjusted the behavior of Scroll and Show All Players and of Increase or Decrease Display to Show all Players
[*]Adjusted so as the priority of the camera is set in the order of players from 1 to 4 and adjusted so as to avoid the camera to move unexpectedly when the other players go out of the camera
[*]Adjusted the Portal Transfer to transfer Child Objects generated by Child Objects too
[*]Adjusted the behavior when the same SE is played simultaneously in a large number
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a crash when moving a layer and referencing an invalid layer
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes (Editor)[/h1][list]
[*]Fixed bugs in the sample games
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause thumbnail to not display the frame settings changes in "Display Direction"
[*]Fixed a bug that caused items not to be displayed when quotations marks are used in the names of switch and variables
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause the information of the selected item not to be updated after a drag and drop in a list
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a crash when playing a sound
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the object not to display when copy and pasting an action enabling  Runtime Action Changeable Event After Placement in Scene
[list][*]When a project is loaded, if there is a similar detection, it will be corrected automatically[/list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused an object enlarged at the size of the scene to be positioned with a slight offset or moving in a different direction
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the specified layer by an action to shift when layers are added or the order changed in a scene
[/list]

How to switch to Branches
1. Open "Properties" for Pixel Game Maker MV in your Steam Library.
2. Select the Beta tab and select the target version and close Properties.

notes.content:
Hi All,

Thank you very much for using Pixel Game Maker MV.
Version 1.0.2.0 has just been released.

[h1]Additions[/h1][list]
[*]Added tutorial and help in Simplified Chinese
[*]Added a Text Search function
[*]Added new settings to "Load a File" in Other Runtime Actions
[*]Added Background to "Change Scrolling Speed" in the Scene Settings
[list][*]In addition, the background setting "Scroll Speed / Direction" has been changed to "Auto Scroll Speed / Direction"[/list]
[*]Added an "Update" option on the right click menu of Resources to update several resources at the same time
[*]Added the functionality that when the Object Variable "Animation Frame" is "-2", the animation is stopped at the frame currently being played
[list][*]After stopping at "-2", the Variable automatically changes to the value of the frame it is stopped at[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes (Player)[/h1][list]
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause "Template Move Settings" to not work as expected after an action involving moving
[*]Fixed a bug that could prevent Particles from being generated by an Object when moving to another Layer
[*]Fixed a bug that could display the same Object several times just after using a Portal Transfer
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a discrepancy between a Child Object and Parent Object's angle
[*]Fixed a bug that caused items to be pasted in reverse order when multiple items were selected, copied and pasted in a list
[*]Fixed a bug that caused items to be added in reverse order when loading several Resources
[*]Fixed a bug that caused an offset in the Overlaps detection
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause fonts to display improperly
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause the game to slow down when there is a lot of text and that the screen shakes
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a reduction of the Move Distance when setting a "Set Direction and Move" after a Template Move
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause Condition Links to not function as expected when the angle of the Object changes
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the Wall Detection to behave unexpectedly while jumping
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause bullets to accumulate if the firing Object is destroyed before the Connection Point is validated
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the landing of a jump from a slope to behave unexpectedly
[*]Fixed a bug that caused an incorrect value being assigned to the Common Variable"Mouse Coordinate X/Y" when zooming in/out with the "Change Camera Display Area"Other Runtime Action
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the Plug-in "Get Object Coordinates from Game Screen" to cause offset in the coordinates when changing the speed of the Layer scrolling
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause the improper display of an Object using Sprite Studio data
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the screen to blacken when loading a file and moving to another scene
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause an offset of the detection of "Distance with Other Objects" when the Layer's Scrolling Speed changes
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a crash when using the Mini Map Plugin
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the animation to not work as expected when set to 0% on "Change Game Speed" or on "Slow Time on Hit Settings"
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented the Object, when jumping with an action and the game speed is changed to 0% with "Change Game Speed" or "Slow Time on Hit Settings", to stop rising at the moment of the release.
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented the animation starting from the next frame when stopping an animation using "Animation frame", and instead running the next Keyframe
[*]Fixed a bug that caused "No. of Same Instance Placed in Scene" to not increase when an object is generated by the condition of "Camera Comes Near"
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the Particles to not display as expected in a scene when executing the Runtime Action "Disable Object"
[/list]

[h1]Adjustment (Player)[/h1][list]
[*]Adjusted below actions so as to stop the count of the Variable used as Timer used by an Object when the Object is stopped
[list][*]Change Game Speed
[*]Disable Layer Motion
[*]Disable Object
[*]Show Text
[*]Display Image
[*]Play Video[/list]
[*]Adjusted the Language Settings in the Project Settings so the main language selected is displayed during test play.  
[list][*]This will not affect built games, the game will select the language of the OS[/list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused a partial display of the screen when using Portal Transfer
[*]Changed the Portal Transfer so that, after a Portal Transfer, if there is another Portal on the position, to transfer on that Portal when conditions are met
[/list]

[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused a crash when copy-pasting a Condition Link made with a Plug-in

notes.title: Version 1.0.1.0 Update
notes.content:
Hi All,

Thank you very much for using Pixel Game Maker MV.
Version 0.1.0.1.0 has just been released. 

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added the functionality to assign fonts per language in the Fonts tab (Resources)
When an existing project is loaded, all languages are assigned the same font
[*]Added the ability to move an object using coordinates from within the current screen during gameplay via the "Move Object" Runtime Action
[*]Added the “Get Object Coordinates from Game Screen” plugin to the list of official plugins
When a plug-in is installed, an action with the same name is added to “Other Runtime Actions”
[*]Added the capability to copy-paste ”Other Condition Settings” by adding the right-click menu for the Screen Flow function
[*]The scroll position of the Scene Editor screen is now maintained per scene
[*]In Display and parent-child relationship → Received Damage as Child Object → “Parent Object HP Changes”, the actual behavior was different. The revised text is “Change Target Parent Object” 
  [list][*] Added the checkbox ”Apply Damage Rate to Parent" to decrease the damage received by the Child Object [/list]　
[*]Added a Beat 'em up example to the Sample projects
[*]When opening the software, the logo displayed when starting the editor has been updated to provide information about the Pixel Game Maker MV Game Development Challenge. It can be clicked to open the Challenge website
[*]Increased the maximum amount of “Undo” operations possible
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes (Player)[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the Action Program and Transition Link Condition "Change Switch/Variable" to behave in an unexpected manner when the target "All" is used
 [list][*] The "All" setting will now determine whether any of the targets have had a switch or variable change that satisfies the configured condition  [/list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Objects with a modified animation scale or center to have differing positions between Scene layout and test play
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the Link Conditions to not work as expected when the "Data of Common Variables and Switches" debug menu is opened
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Gimmick Tile and Portal switches to respond poorly to touching Objects
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented the Opacity setting from working as expected when using the "Sequence for Overlaps" settings
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the "Generate Object" to not work when performed via the "Object Settings After Destruction" function
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented Objects from climbing Slopes when "Don't Drop Levels" is enabled for "Template Move Settings"
[*]Fixed a bug that could prevent the BGM from playing after repeated Save/Load operations
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Physics Objects that had been added by the Physics Calculation Related Settings to be affected by display scale changes
[*]Fixed a bug that could prevent Objects from interacting with Physics Objects after changing Layers via Portal
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented the Physics Influence settings for an Object from being changed by a Switch
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Afterimages to not be displayed when the Interval value was too short
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the Camera to ignore its initial position when moving the Camera via Course while auto scrolling is enabled for the Scene
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Tiles with an Opacity value of less than 255 to turn white during Transitions
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a crash or a significant offset when an Object with added Physics Calculation Parts moves to another layer
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the Object not changing directions when touching an upper or lower Wall
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented the "Animation frame" Variable from functioning as intended
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause Objects moving with the "Random" parameter for "Template Move Settings" to stop moving after colliding with a Wall
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the F5 reset to restart the game with the incorrect settings
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the "Shoot at the Selected On-Screen Object Group(s)" parameter for "Bullet Settings" to prioritize the newer Objects when several Objects/Groups are selected
 [list][*] The closest Objects will now be targeted  [/list]
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause text display corruption when using the "Shake Scene" Runtime Action
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause Tile Groups and Objects that should not touch to be treated as touching
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the Bullets to stop spawning after disabling then re-enabling Layer motion in some cases
"[*]Fixed a bug that could result in Objects becoming offset due to an improperly detected animation Origin when the animation's Origin and Center are not the same point or an Offset has been used to adjust the animation
 [list][*]  Any Runtime Actions that rely on parameters such as “Center of This Object” (including “Generate Object” and “Move Object”) are affected by this fix.  [/list]"
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause the camera to become offset when an Object moves to another layer
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a Gimmick Tile using the "When Object Overlaps Tile" setting to function even when the Layer it is placed in is disabled
[*] Fixed a problem that caused an Object to be able to be moved if it is riding on top of another Object even when the "Not Pushed Back by Other Objects" setting is enabled
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause Bullets to be fired in a group if the Connection Point used to fire those Bullets is only enabled during the animation
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a crash when using Disable Layer Motion while displaying an effect using a Gimmick Tile
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause "Move Toward Display Direction" to function in unexpected ways when a Tile is touched 
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a Scene to crash when an Animation without a Motion is placed in that Scene
[*]Fixed a bug that prevents the Enlarge Display setting to not offer the x5~8 parameters when playing a game
[*]Fixed a bug that prevents Objects from changing Actions until the "Move Object" action is completed, even if a valid Link Condition allows Action change
[*]Fixed a bug that could prevent an Object from being pushed if it is moving fast/has a lot of inertia
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause small Offset values from not displaying correctly during testplay when using              Interpolation
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the "Bound" parameter for "Template Move Settings" to not work when the Object hits a wall
[*]Fixed a bug that could prevent Overlap settings from being rendered properly if a partially transparent Tile is placed in a foreground Layer
[*]Fixed a bug that caused SpriteStudio data to behave differently when previewed and during gameplay
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Afterimages to not work as expected after increasing the game's speed
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the Gimmick Tile "When Tile's Attack Detection is Touched" setting from not working when attacks are received from certain directions
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the Parent Object's Offset to be ignored when a Child Object is following the Parent Object
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause pixel information to be lost in some cases when a Scene Layer's Scroll Speed is not at 100%
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Object Effects to remain visible even if the Scene changes or is otherwise hidden
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Objects to always be displayed in the foreground when using a Portal
[*]Fixed a bug that could prevent a Tile from being detected as a part of the correct Tile Group if that Tile was changed as a result of using the "Change tile" function for Gimmick Tiles
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented Bullets from being generated with the correct orientation for Objects using animations created using the "Rotate and Auto-generate" setting
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Objects moved with "Move Object" to have an incorrect Origin point
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a crash when the "Data of Common Variables and Switches" debug menu is opened
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a crash when opening the Operation settings (keymap) for built games
 [*]Fixed a bug that caused the Objects generated by Gimmick Tiles to behave in an unexpected manner
[/list]

[h1]Adjustments (Player) [/h1]
[list]
[*]Adjusted movement handling for Objects to reduce the chances of getting caught on a Slope
[*]Revised Portal movement to prevent duplicating an Action that was being performed when Portal movement was initiated
[*]Changed looping Effects and Particles generated by an Object so that they do not disappear after using a Portal
[*]Revised behavior of the "Stick to Parent Object" setting to reduce occurences of collision detection issues for the Child Object
[*]The Player Detection Object variable is now limited to the values 0~4.
[*]Improved performance of the "Other Runtime Actions" and "Other Condition Settings" window
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes and Changes (Editor)[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused a behavorial difference between the layout view and test play when the "Keep Aspect Ratio and Enlarge" is checked for Backgrounds in the Scene Settings
[*]Fixed a bug that caused unusual scroll behavior in some situations when selecting items in a list with Ctrl+click
[*]Fixed a bug that could prevent the addition of a Keyframe for Effect Animations 
[*]Fixed some assorted UI issues
[*]Fixed several bugs that could result in a crash
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the Tile's Animation Preview to take a longer time than the actual time
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a crash when adding many Tilesets to a Scene
[*]Projects without configured Language Settings will be assigned the OS language when they are next loaded
[*]Fixed a bug that caused an error with the "Load" or "Update" buttons when a Resource is deleted from the Project folder and not from the Editor
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause settings for a different animation to be displayed
[*]Fixed a bug that could prevent large Projects from being opened
[*]Revised the "Show Message" Plug-in to continuously displayed messages without opening/closing the text window when executing multiple Show Message actions within the same Runtime Action
 [list][*]To update an existing project using this plug-in, click the "Update" button on the Plug-in tab and the plug-in will update to the new version [/list]
[/list]

"How to switch to Branches"
1. Open "Properties" for Pixel Game Maker MV in your Steam Library.
2. Select the Beta tab and select the target version and close Properties.

"How to switch to Default"
Please execute the following process to revert from other versions to the current release.
1. Open "Properties" for Pixel Game Maker MV in your Steam Library.
2. Select "None - don't participate in any Beta programs" and close Properties.

notes.content:
Everyone,

Our apologies for the extra day of wait:
The 30-day trial is now available for download!

To clarify, this 30-day trial will give you full access to develop your own game in Pixel Game Maker MV. The only limitation on what you can do (besides the 30-day thing) is that you can't build a game for stand-alone use.

We hope you will give it a try, and take your first steps towards becoming an amazing game creator!

Additionally, we are running a 30% sale from now until October 3rd to celebrate the release of version 1.0.0 yesterday, so if you enjoy your time with the trial don't miss this opportunity.

Stay tuned for more updates and news, and thanks for your support!

notes.title: Out of Early Access! Pixel Game Maker MV 1.0.0 Update!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

We are proud to announce the release of the v1.0.0 of Pixel Game Maker MV!
We received a lot of constructive feedback during the Early Access, and it helped us to improve the software greatly.

In addition to our coming out of the Early Access period, we are also about to release a 30-day trial version of Pixel Game Maker MV! 

Also, don't forget about the upcoming [b]Pixel Game Maker MV Game Development Challenge![/b]
The contest will start on [b]October 3rd[/b], and the winner will have their submission released on the Nintendo Switch. Any combination of art style and genre are welcome!
For more info, please visit our Itch.io page from October 3rd.
Please give it a try! We are looking forward to seeing your projects!

October 3rd will also see a physical release of Pixel Game Maker MV in Japan, but Steam users shall not be forgotten! To celebrate the launch, Pixel Game Maker is [b]now 30% off![/b]

Finally, 1.0.0 is not the final update for Pixel Game Maker MV!
We spent our time in Early Access focused on building a stable platform, and we feel that we have finally achieved that goal.
Going forward, our focus will be on addressing user requests for quality of life and functional enhancements, such as UI refinements or the addition of functionality like a database system.
Please stay excited for these future updates as we continue onwards!

Thank you for your support of Pixel Game Maker MV!

[h1]■Updates[/h1]

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*]Updated the End User License Agreement
[*]Added the Steel Sword Story (Demo) and La Mulana 2 sample projects
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes (Player)[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause Objects to be detected as being incorrectly in the air when on a Slope
[/list]

1. Open "Properties" for Pixel Game Maker MV in your Steam Library.
2. Select the Beta tab and select the target version and close Properties.

"How to switch to Default"

notes.title: Version 0.9.7.1 Update
notes.content:
Hi All,

Thank you very much for using Pixel Game Maker MV.
Version 0.9.7.1 has just been released. Please check the Steam properties Beta tab to access previous versions.

Additionally, the Player Performance Preview build has also received updates, which are included in the following releases notes.

[h1]■Updates[/h1]

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added coordinate information for physics simulation parts to the Scene layout panels
[*]Added x5, x6, x7, and x8 to the Project "Enlarged Display" settings
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes (Default & Preview)[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that let the system know when an Object reached the top of its jump
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause some stickiness when a Slope is placed in front of a Gimmick Tile
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause an Object to get stuck to a wall if an Action Node change occurs with no condition when next to the edge of the valid movement area
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause an Object using Template Move Settings from going up or down a Slope when "Don't Drop Levels" is selected
[*]Fixed a bug that could allow Objects to act even when "Stop All Object Motions" is selected for "Play Video" or "Display Image"
[*]Fixed a bug that would result in Parent-Child relationships not being maintained on Save/Load operations
[*]Fixed a bug that would prevent Objects from updating their display direction when using "Template Move Settings"
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented Object Locking from working as intended when an Object is using a Field of Vision or Lighting setting
[*]Fixed a bug where Child Objects could be scaled to twice the intended size when inheriting Scale from the Parent Object
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause Child Objects to rotate too much when using the "Rotate and Auto-generate" animation setting
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented Gimmick Tiles from functioning on using the Overlaps Tile condition
[*]Fixed a bug that would apply anti-alias improperly in some cases when using the "Show Text" Action
[*]Fixed a bug where Gimmick Tils would not properly update in some cases when an Object moving via "Template Move Settings" triggered the tile
[*]Fixed a bug where Objects displayed in the menu were being improperly rotated based on the current Scene
[*]Fixed a bug where Objects assigned to the Player Group would stop following assigned Courses after a Save/Load operation
[*]Fixed a bug where animations could rarely become offset by 1 frame
[*]Fixed a bug where following Child Objects would follow the Parent Object improperly after Scene start
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a crash when moving via Portal when an Object has "Maintain State at End of Scene" enabled
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a crash when previewing particle animations
[*]Fixed a bug that was preventing the "Releasing" Condition from working as intended
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing the "Invincibility" status from lasting longer than specified
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented animations carried over from a Transition from not working after a Save/Load operation
[*]Fixed a bug that made it possible for Objects with multiple wall collision detection areas to get stuck in a wall in certain cases
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented the "Change Camera Display Area" function from working as intended immediately after loading a Scene
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause unintended interactions between Objects on a Course and Slopes
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause a crash if an image-based font has a blank Character Placement field 
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause the HP variable to become -1 after adjusting variable values using Course movement, Gimmick Tiles, or Portal movement
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause Gimmick Tiles to detect the initial scale values for an Object after changing that Object's scale
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause Objects with the "Restore with Action" setting to restore according "Scene Changed" condition
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause Gimmick Tiles to be improperly triggered by Objects in other Layers
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause Tiles to be improperly colored after changing a Tile's color and then editing a Gimmick Tile
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause the Player Object to become unresponsive depending on certain combinations of Gravity strength and direction
[*]Fixed a bug that could improper display of text when text is displayed in certain positions on screen
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause animations that play in reverse from working properly after a Common Action has been used
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause unintended slow movement speeds after a fast moving Object switches to the "Template Move Settings" Action
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes (Player Preview)[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing a memory leak on frequent uses of Portal transitions
[*]Fixed a bug that could result in Object bouncing back from a collision with another Object
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause the debug functions to no longer be displayed
[*]Fixed a bug that could allow effect animations to still be played even when the layer 
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause improper display offset when using the Slide (Link) setting for Portals
[*]Fixed a bug that cause adjustments to spawn location for the "Generate Object" Action from taking effect in some cases
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes (Default Player)[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause unintended visual effects when two Screen Effects are used simultaneously
[*]Fixed a bug that was affecting display priority for particle animations
[*]Fixed a bug that was affecting coordinate locations for particle animations
[/list]

[h1]Changes/Adjustments (Default & Preview)[/h1]
[list]
[*]Adjusting coordinate update timing for Objects at the start of a Scene
[*]Adjusted behavior of tracking Bullets to continue movement in a straight line if the tracked Object is destroyed by something other than the Bullet
[/list]

[h1]Editor Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented changes to tile coloring from updating in real-time
[*]Fixed a bug that was affecting physics simulation testing
[*]Fixed a bug that was limiting the area accessible in menu Scenes to just 320x180 regardless of other Project Settings when creating a blank Project
[list]
[*]Old projects affected by this bug while have the menu Scene adjusted to have the Area Accessible set to the size of the Scene
[/list]
[*]Fixed assorted UI bugs
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause a crash after deleting all scenes in some situations
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented users from being able to remove encryption when building a game
[*]Fixed a bug that would prevent SpriteStudio data conversion if the Windows user name includes Japanese characters
[/list]

"How to switch to Branches"
1. Open "Properties" for Pixel Game Maker MV in your Steam Library.
2. Select the Beta tab and select the target version and close Properties.

"How to switch to Default"
Please execute the following process to revert from other versions to the current release.
1. Open "Properties" for Pixel Game Maker MV in your Steam Library.
2. Select "None - don't participate in any Beta programs" and close Properties.

notes.title: Version 0.9.7 Update
notes.content:
Hi All,

Thank you very much for using Pixel Game Maker MV.
Version 0.9.7 has just been released. Please check the Steam properties Beta tab to access previous versions.

Additionally, the Player Performance Preview build has also received updates, which are included in the following releases notes.

As was previously announced, with the release of the 0.9.7 update, development of the 32-bit release has ceased. Please switch over to the 64-bit or Performance Preview. The older 32-bit releases will remain available via the Steam beta menu.

[h1]■Updates[/h1]

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a setting to retain Parent/Child settings after using the "Change Object" Runtime Action
[*]Added a setting for freeze frames/slowdown on a successful attack to the "Recevied Damage" Object tab
[*]Added a setting to enable or disable distance settings when using the "Move Towards the Display Direction" Runtime Action
[*]Added a setting to define movement distance to the "Set Move Direction and Move" Runtime Action
[*]Added additional Object controls when moving through a Portal
[*]Enabled the right-click menu to Object sub menu lists, such as used by Bullet Shot Settings or Received Damage
[*]Enhanced function of the "Check Motion" part of Action Nodes.
[*]Added ability to stop processing on menu items hidden using the "Hide Menu Screen" Runtime Action
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes (Default & Preview)[/h1]
[list]
[*]Revised some Link Condition Object collision checks using "All Objects" or "Object Other than Self" to hanlde processing with OR condition instead of AND condition
[*]Fixed a bug that was preventing the "Critical Received" Switch from functioning as intended
[*]Fixed a bug that would prevent Objects from moving correctly if they had differing values for top-bottom & left-right movement speed
[*]Fixed a bug that could prevent Portal movement when Portals are overlapping
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause Scene Objects to interact with the wrong Tiles after Loading
[*]Fixed a bug that was preventing the "Flip on Y-axis" function from working as intended
[*]Fixed a bug affecting Springs attached to an Object
[*]Fixed a bug that caused "Push/Pull Object" to give inaccurate results
[*]Fixed a bug that caused constant collisions when one Object would stand on another Object
[*]Fixed a memory leak when starting and stopping music playback
[*]Fixed a bug that was allowing button presses to be accepted during screen Transitions
[*]Fixed a bug with Bullet Objects when that Object's display direction is changed by a Parent Object
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause incorrect camera movement when moving between Layers
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause Objects to be placed in the wrong location when previewing Objects that are limited to the Camera display area
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause an Object to lose invincibility if it was forced to move via a Runtime Action during the invincibility period
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause an Object to get temporarily stuck to a the bottom of a slope
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented Objects using the "Template Move" setting from being able to climb Slopes in some instances
[*]Fixed a bug that caused incorrect key input detection immediately after using a Portal when using a keyboard
[*]Fixed a bug that resulted in slightly incorrect in Slope detection
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Links to cease functioning if a Portal was used in the middle of a Common Action
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Parent-Child relationships to be lost after moving between Layers
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause "Auto-adjust Diagonal Move Speed" to cease functioning in same cases
[*]Fixed a bug that could prevent Courses from working when used in a menu scene
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause particle effects from working as intended inside menu scenes
[*]Fixed a bug that could prevent changing of the Camera display area
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented the disabling of a Camera using the "Area Accessible By Camera" Scene setting
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause Objects to become duplicated upon a Scene change
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause a crash when a physics Object was created inside a menu Scene
[*]Fixed a bug that would an Object from ever respawning after loading a Save that was performed while that Object was destroyed
[*]Fixed a bug where circle-type Courses would move in a different order from that configured in the Editor
[*]Fixed a bug where Switches and Variables couldn't be changed on the Start Point for a Course
[*]Fixed a bug that could prevent the Object "Invicibility" Switch from functioning
[*]Fixed a bug that would result in overly large speeds if the game speed is changed while using the "Push/Pull Object" Runtime Action
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause Gimmick Tiles to trigger even though the Tile is not touched
[/list]

[h1]Preview Only Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a crash when using the "Execute Object Action" Runtime Action
[*]Fixed a bug that could prevent animations made with SpriteStudio from being displayed when certain Camera settings are used
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a crash in certain situations when a Gimmick Tile is triggered
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a crash when no Object is assigned to a Connection Point
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause a Child Object from being displayed if a Connection Point was not properly assigned
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause Gimmick Tiles to be triggered from other Layers in some cases
[*]Fixed a bug that resulted in the incorrect display of an Object when partially overlapped
[/list]

[h1]Standard Release Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue when using the "Bound" setting for the "Template Movement" Runtime Action
[/list]

[h1]Changes/Adjustments (Default & Preview)[/h1]
[list]
[*]Stabilized Axis rotating in the clockwise direction
[*]Improved handling of Ropes
[*]Improved wall collision detection to reduced instances of clipping between Objects
[*]Improved handling of GIF data to ensure proper display
[*]Fixed Objects getting stuck in air when no animation was assigned to the Jump action
[*]Adjust damage spread values for attacks to only use integers
[list]
[*]However, critical hits and other specialized damage Runtime Actions can still be configured to use decimals
[/list]
[*]Object movement direction is now taken into account when determining if a Portal transition should occur again
[/list]

[h1]Changes/Adjustments (Default Only)[/h1]
[list]
[*]Adjusted pushback handling when Objects have overlapping wall detection areas
[/list]

[h1]Editor Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause the Tile tool to have unintended behavior after changing a Project's tile size setting
[*]Fixed an assortment of small bugs
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a crash when moving an Object into the foreground
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause Scenes from being placeable in the Transitions tool
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause a Layer deleted from a particle animation to remain in effect
[*]Fixed particle animations so that a negative value for the lifetime and amount settings could not be input
[*]Fixed an issue with particle animations when using the Loop or Simultaneous Generation settings
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a crash when creating a Scene without an assigned Tileset
[*]Fixed a bug that could result in changes made to sound left/right balance to not be properly sent to the Player
[*]Fixed a bug that could prevent new Variables or Switches from being added within the "Change Switch/Variable" Runtime Action
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause the Origin Point display in the Animation tool to have the incorrect visual display after zooming
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause the "Apply Same Settings for B->A" Portal setting from functioning as desired
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a crash after making changes to a Course "Set Point" setting
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause Course point order issues after deleting or adding a point to the Course
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause issues after opening and closing the Scene Effects dialog within the Scene Settings dialog
[*]Fixed a bug that could prevent image saving after switching the image used for the Project (Game Data dialog), if the image format used was GIF
[*]Fixed a bug where can Object could refer to an incorrect Switch in certain cases
[*]Fixed a bug sometimes causing a crash when zooming the animation preview UI element
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause multiple items to be created when adding a folder to a list view
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause data loss when moving an item from upper level folder to a lower level folder in some cases
[*]Fixed a bug that prevent the origin point for a particle animation to not be updated when the animation is currently being previewed
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause a crash when making adjustments for a Rope while the physics simulation is enabled
[*]Fixed a bug that cause unexpected differences in physics simulation results based on whether or not an Object has an assigned animation
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a crash when adjusting Scenes using the Screen Flow function
[/list]

[h1]Editor Fixes (Performance Preview)[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause a crash when adding a Scene Effect when a Scene has a lot of Layers
[/list]

"How to switch to Branches"
1. Open "Properties" for Pixel Game Maker MV in your Steam Library.
2. Select the Beta tab and select the target version and close Properties.

"How to switch to Default"
Please execute the following process to revert from other versions to the current release.
1. Open "Properties" for Pixel Game Maker MV in your Steam Library.
2. Select "None - don't participate in any Beta programs" and close Properties.

notes.title: Version 0.9.6.2 Update
notes.content:
Hi All,

Thank you very much for using Pixel Game Maker MV.
Version 0.9.6.2 has just been released. Please check the Steam properties Beta tab to access previous versions.

Additionally, the Player Performance Preview build has also received updates, which are included in the following releases notes.

As the release of the Player Performance Preview is having the intended results, we are proceeding with plans to end development of the existing player and replace it with the revised version upon the ending of Early Access in the near future.

[h1]■Updates[/h1]

[h1]Bug Fixes (Default & Preview)[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where certain processes were processed at an incorrect timing
[*]Fixed an issue where unneeded GPU resources were being used
[*]Fixed a bug that caused child Objects to not function as intended after a load 
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause input to be retained and continue after using a portal
[*]Fixed the following issues with the "Increase or Decrease Display to Show all Players" function:
[list]
    [*]Fixed bug that prevented proper scaling after the number of Objects being tracked is decreased
    [*]Fixed bug that prevented the "Set Max Scale (%)" setting from being applied properly
[/list]

notes.title: Release of Player Performance Preview Build
notes.content:
Greetings all!

As many you have been requesting for several months, we have been hard at work on a major performance enhancement for Pixel Game Maker MV games.

If you go to the new beta branch, Player Performance Preview, you can try an early test version of this new player component.

This new player should offer much improved performance over the existing player component, whether you are testing your game from the editor component or sharing a built game with a friend.

However, as it is still in a more experimental state, please understand that there could be more bugs in the standard release. We hope that anyone that gives this preview build a try will be sure to share your feedback with us!

[h1]■Updates[/h1]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
 [*] Fixed a bug that caused transparency settings to be applied twice to particles
[/list]

[h1]Changes/Adjustments[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved performance when no screen effects are in use
 [*] Added 2 new layer selections to the Scenes Effects selection menu
  Compared to other selections, these new selections should have higher performance
  To disable the new "Foremost Layer + Menu" selection, the same setting must be selected
  The new Foremost Layer setting can be disabled via disabling "Foremost Layer" or "All Layers in Scene"
 [*] Changed the name of the Screen Effect setting "All" to "All Layers in Scene". No function changes were made
 [*] Fixed performance when playing the game in an enlarged window
[*] Revised collision detection to now be handled via multi-threaded processing
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.9.6 Update & Request to Update to 64-bit Version
notes.content:
Hi All,

Thank you very much for using Pixel Game Maker MV.

With the release today of 0.9.6, we must inform you that the 0.9.6 series of releases will be the last versions of Pixel Game Maker MV to support 32-bit systems.
From version 0.9.7 onward, only 64-bit versions will be released. We will be updating the recommended specs accordingly. We will keep the 32-bit version available for those users who are currently unable to switch to the 64-bit release, so please check the Betas tab if you need access to that version.

Also, version 0.9.6 has just been released. 
It includes a large number of fixes and improvements.
With this release, 0.9.6 has been released directly to the default branch. Older releases will be made available via branches in the Beta tab (Steam properties)

[h1]■Updates[/h1]

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*]The "On Press" and "On Release" Link Conditions for input now have a input frame acceptance setting 
[*]Input Method can now be selected even when using the "On 8-Directional Press" setting for Input Conditions
[*]A maximum value can now be assigned to gauges via the Display and parent-child relationship settings panel
[*]The Increase/Decrease Object HP now has an adjustable interval setting
[*]Debug settings are now saved when closing a test play window 
[*]Added a setting to disable anti-aliasing on particles
[*]Added a final angle & relative angle setting for particles
[*]The Parent Object can now be selected when assigning a Switch or Variable for various settings
[*]Added a new function to allow the auto-scroll function for scenes to be controllable via a Switch
[*]Added a new variable to save current playback time to the "Audio Playback"
[*]Added the new Runtime Action of "Save Playhead Start Time"
[*]Individual volumes can now be adjusted separately
The volume level can now be adjusted during gameplay, with the master volume assigned in the project settings being 100%
[*]Added a new variable to store Object Orientation
[*]Added a new setting to limit Course movement via a Switch
[*]Added two new sample projects, a puzzle project and a top view shooting
[*]Added current layer information to Object debug information
[*]Added new variable to store Parent Object Instance ID
[*]Added some information regarding SpriteStudio data to the Help
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes (Player)[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed several potential memory leaks 
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause Objects spawned by another Object's default action to be duplicated
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the camera area detection to be shifted to the left
[*]Fixed a bug that caused a crash when headphones are inserted during test play
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a moving Object to not stop after moving the specified amount
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the camera display area to become improperly offset when using the "Change Camera Display Area" Action to assign the camera to be smaller than 100%
[*]Fixed a bug that could prevent the camera display area restrictions from being applied properly
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause sound effects added directly from the Gimmick Tile interface from working properly
[*]Fixed a bug that could allow Objects to move faster than the assigned maximum speed value
[*]Fixed a bug that caused cameras to ignore the specified maximum scaling value
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause the Object to use the default value when changing damage via the Attack Settings Action
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause an Object to sang on a slope
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented the blur lighting function from working when using certain Screen effects
[*]Fixed a bug that affected Objects firing Bullets when moving using Back and Forth Moving and Turning
[*]Fixed a bug that could apply invincibility to on-screen text when an Object takes damage
[*]Fixed a bug that caused a Connection Point to exist for a motion even when there is no keyframe in the animation timeline
[*]Fixed a bug where tile assignments could become misconfigured after adding additional Tile Groups
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause collision with tiles that should be a target for collision 
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause the camera to become offset when the camera is set to follow an Object that changes layers
[*]Fixed a bug with the firing of Bullets when no Shooting Method is assigned
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a slow down when using a timer function during test play with debug functions
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a temporary incorrect action when using a Common Action to perform a "Execute Object Action"
[*]Fixed a bug affecting game display when the framerate drops below 60 FPS
[*]Fixed a bug where assigning a new move speed via the "Move Object" Action could be applied to other movement Actions
[*]Fixed a bug where Template Move Settings could be applied by other Runtime Actions
[*]Fixed a bug where afterimages could receive uninteneded effects from changing the game speed 
[*]Fixed a bug where changing the game speed could cause an animation to become desynced
[*]Fixed a bug where an Object using Back and Forth Moving and Turning could be pushed back by other Objects, even when that setting is disabled
[*]Fixed a bug where the Object Switch "Disable" was not working as intended in some cases
[*]Fixed a bug where connected Objects could become improperly offset after a portal transition
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause Object coordinates to not be updated if the coordinates were changed in the initial Action 
[*]Fixed a bug that could delete Tiles if a physics was enabled on an Object
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause screen scrolling to be incorrect
[*]Fixed a bug that resulted in some Switches & Variables not being processed properly on Save/Load operations
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause Object Wall Detection areas to overlap
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause Player movement limitations to be disabled after using Change Camera Display Area
[*]Fixed a bug that could result in Objects not falling if a tile's wall detection is touched at the peak of a jump
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause "Auto-adjust Association Within Specified Dots" to not function in some situations
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause an Object to retain the coordinates of the previous Scene after using a portal to move to a different Scene
[*]Fixed a bug that was preventing the "Contact with a Tile's Wall Detection When Moving One Tile" from working as intended
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing gravity settings to generate discrepancies in how long it took to destroy Objects 
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause Objects to move further than intended when using Runtime Action movement commands
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause incorrect controller IDs after using the F5 reset key
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause camera zoom settings to be lost after switching cameras
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause the camera and Scene to become offset when the camera display area is equal to the Scene size
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause unintended behavior when an Object fired as a Bullet uses the "Stop" setting from "Template Move Settings"
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a crash when two Objects are connected via a Connection Point and the base Object is destroyed
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause Common Actions to be repeated for no reason in rare circumstances
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause an Object to not update the display direction when a motion is inherited via the "Takes over a motion" setting
*If not wanting to update the display direction on purpose, make use of the "Ignore Direction Change During Motion" setting
[*]Fixed a bug that could result in the Save File, Load File, Delete File, and Copy File Switches not functioning as expected if enabled-disabled quickly  
[*]Fixed a bug that would allow input from unsupported controllers by forcibly assigning a non-existent Controller ID
[*]Fixed a bug that caused text displayed on the menu Scene to be blurry
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause hitching when traversing a reversed Circle Course
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause a crash if a Bullet was fired with only a Connection Point configured in the animation data for that Object
[/list]

[h1]Changes/Adjustments (Player)[/h1]
[list]
[*]Enabled Lighting elements to rotate with the Object they are applied to
[*]Updated behavior of the save file loading and copying operations
[*]Updated Player Group Objects to continue following Template Movement if that movement was interrupted by another non-movement Action
*Movement from an input device will always cancel Template Move settings
[*]Adjusted Attack Settings so that they are updated more frequently 
[*]Reduced performance impact of the official Minimap plug-in
* If already using this plugin in a project, please access the plug-in list and refresh the plug-in to update to the new version
[*]Objects are no longer displayed if the Object they are Connected to has an empty Connection Point keyframe
[*]Revised Bullet settings to prevent Bullets from being fired if the firing Object has an empty Connection Point keyframe
[*]An Object can no longer be spawned if the spawning Object has an empty Connection Point keyframe
[*]Revised the Save File/Load File functions to properly save Object XY scale values
[*]Object relational coordinates are now fixed for Objects spawned via Connection Points
* To make fine adjustments to the display location, please adjust the Connection Point
[*]Revised handling to prevent a possible crash that could occur when loading a save file created with an older version of the project
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes (Editor)[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that could incorrectly introduce decimal numbers when placing an Object in a Scene
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a crash when clicked on UI elements while editing an Object name
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause the background to display improperly after setting the transparency value to 0 and reloading editor
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a crash when repeatedly opening different Projects with various Tile sizes
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause the flag icon to be display in the incorrect location after switching scenes and assigning a new Start Scene
[*]Fixed a bug that could sometimes cause a crash when opening a list folder while list icons were being updated
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause an invalid Layer to be displayed in the project after deleting a Layer
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause a crash if a Gimmick Tile was deleted while that tile's Gimmick Settings were actively displayed
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a crash after switching from the Object tab to the Transitions tab and performing some edits
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause an Object with an enabled transparency setting to be displayed improperly in some sitations
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause invalid data involving coordinates and scaling settings for Objects using an animation that contains empty frame information, when that Object is placed in a Scene
[*]Fixed a bug that could rarely cause a crash after performing Copy/Paste, Undo, and Redo actions when editing an Object's Action Program
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a crash if a Switch and a Folder shared the same name
[*]Fixed a bug that could rarely cause a crash when opening the Scene Settings dialogue
[*]Fixed the text tag for the Help section regarding Variables
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause the "Set Action Display Direction Separately" to be reset after switching tabs
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a crash after changing animation frames while another frame's thumbnail is being generated
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause a numerical spin box to continuously increase if the focus window is changed
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause the display direction to become empty for the "Set Move Direction and Move"
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause the points for a Circle Course to become offset
[/list]

[h1]Changes/Adjustments (Editor)[/h1]
[list]
[*]Updated Build path to output to the assigned folder, and allow direct text editing of the path
[*]Adjusted new keyframes for detection areas so that they now spawn at the size of the sprite used for the animation frame
[*]Angles of 15 degrees can now be force selected by holding the Shift key when adjusting angles via the angle selection UI
[*]Objects are now displayed using their configured display directions upon being placed into a Scene
[/list]

[h1]Changes/Adjustments (Sprite Studio)[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue that could result in incorrect coordinates for animations imported from a SSPJ file
[*]Mask and mask strength are now properly supported
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause instance animations to be improperly offset
[/list]

1. Open "Properties" for Pixel Game Maker MV in your Steam Library.
2. Select the Beta tab and select the target version and close Properties.
